messages:
Noah Kim: quick a11y review of the dashboard filter chips — spotted two issues: focus ring barely visible on dark theme and screen reader announces just 'button' for some chips. Sofia Marques: thanks — which chips? the tag chips in the left rail or the active filters row? Noah Kim: active filters row (top of results). When chip is focused with keyboard the outline is 1px gray on dark bg. Hard to see. Also the remove 'x' inside chip is an icon button with aria-label missing in one variant. Julian Park: I can repro the weak outline. CSS token --focus-ring is 1px by default. We should switch to 3px for high contrast like WCAG suggests for visibility. Mina Desai: for SR announcments: prefer descriptive names like "Remove filter: model size equals medium" instead of generic "button". Use aria-label on the inner remove button and aria-roledescription on chip group if helpful. a11y-bot: automated-check: chip contrast ratio (text vs chip-bg) = 3.5:1 (fails 4.5), focus ring thickness <3px flagged, missing aria-label on .chip__remove in 2 instances. Sofia Marques: approach: 1) increase focus ring thickness to 3px and change color to --focus-accent-strong, 2) ensure chips have clear accessible name, 3) keep visual compactness but increase hit target for remove to 44px. Noah Kim: small code suggestion: — but nested button isn't valid HTML. Need to restructure. Julian Park: yep avoid nested buttons. Use
. Or use single button with aria-haspopup and a separate focusable span for remove. Mina Desai: prefer separate sibling button for remove for keyboard clarity:
. Keep remove label visually hidden if we want icon-only. Sofia Marques: also test with VoiceOver rotor and NVDA quick navigation. For keyboard, ensure tab order moves to each actionable control (chip then remove) not skip over. a11y-bot: suggestion: run storybook axe-check and add a cypress test that tabs through chips and asserts the visible focus is on the element and aria-labels exist. Noah Kim: I'll add PR with the focus ring/token change and chip markup updates (no nested buttons). Will include visual diff for dark theme and a short accessibility checklist in the PR description. Julian Park: tiny styling note: keep chip padding but increase remove hit area with negative margin on icon so layout looks same but target is larger. Mina Desai: copy nit for SR: use full phrase "Remove filter: React" not just "Remove" so context isn't lost. Sofia Marques: great. Assigning to @Noah to open draft PR. :thumbsup: Noah Kim: on it, will ping when draft is up.
